# Migration 0.1.1 → 0.1.2

This is a new package version. Candidate 0.1.1 remains frozen and usable on Hosts that do not implement `tool.open.v1`; 0.1.2 requires exactly `=1.0.0-preview.1` and must only be installed on a Host that advertises that profile. The compute module and eight capability contracts are unchanged. The added callback selects an operation UI only.
